questions.stem: A student places a plant on a windowsill and observes that after a few days, the shoot has bent towards the light. Which plant hormone is responsible, and how does it cause this bending?

options.text: Gibberellin accumulates on the dark side, causing cells there to die
Auxin redistributes to the shaded side of the shoot, causing cells there to elongate more, bending the shoot towards the light
Auxin accumulates on the lit side, causing cells there to grow faster
Ethylene causes the cells on the light side to shrink

questions.explanation: In phototropism, light causes auxin to move to the shaded side of the shoot tip. Higher auxin concentration on the shaded side stimulates greater cell elongation there, causing the shoot to bend towards the light. This is a positive phototropic response.

questions.stem: A student investigates gravitropism by placing a seedling on its side in the dark. After 48 hours, the root has grown downwards and the shoot has grown upwards. How does auxin produce opposite responses in roots and shoots?

options.text: Auxin has no effect on roots; only shoots respond to gravity
Auxin accumulates on the lower side in both; it stimulates elongation in shoots (bending up) but inhibits elongation in roots (bending down)
Different hormones control roots and shoots entirely
Gravity directly pushes the root down without any hormone involvement

questions.explanation: Gravity causes auxin to accumulate on the lower side of both the root and shoot. Shoot cells are stimulated by high auxin, so the lower side elongates more, bending the shoot upward. Root cells are inhibited by high auxin, so the upper side elongates more, bending the root downward.

questions.stem: Charles Darwin and his son carried out experiments where they covered the tips of grass coleoptiles with opaque caps. The plants no longer bent towards light. What did this demonstrate about the role of the tip?

options.text: That the entire shoot is sensitive to light
That the tip is where light is detected and where the hormone (auxin) is produced, which then moves down to cause bending
That light must reach all parts of the plant for growth to occur
That opaque caps release chemicals that prevent growth

questions.explanation: By covering only the tip, Darwin showed that the tip is essential for detecting light direction. The tip produces auxin, which is redistributed and moves down the shoot to the elongation zone where it causes differential growth. Without the tip sensing light, there is no directional redistribution of auxin.

questions.stem: Ethylene (ethene) is a gaseous plant hormone. Fruit producers sometimes store unripe bananas in sealed containers with ethylene gas. Why?

options.text: Ethylene prevents the fruit from ripening, keeping it fresh longer
Ethylene stimulates fruit ripening, allowing producers to control when bananas become ripe for sale
Ethylene gives bananas their yellow colour without actually ripening them
Ethylene kills bacteria on the fruit surface

questions.explanation: Ethylene is a natural plant hormone that promotes fruit ripening. By exposing unripe bananas to ethylene gas in controlled conditions, producers can trigger ripening at the desired time, ensuring bananas reach shops at the perfect stage of ripeness.

questions.stem: Gibberellins are plant hormones that can promote seed germination and stem elongation. A farmer has a batch of seeds with low germination rates. How might gibberellins help?

options.text: Gibberellins would kill the dormant seeds and allow new ones to grow
Gibberellins can break seed dormancy by stimulating the production of enzymes that break down food stores, promoting germination
Gibberellins replace the need for water in seed germination
Gibberellins make the seed coat harder, protecting the seed

questions.explanation: Gibberellins can break seed dormancy by triggering the production of amylase and other enzymes that break down starch reserves in the seed into sugars. This provides energy for the embryo to grow, promoting germination even in seeds that would otherwise remain dormant.
